images.title: A library corner and its key
images.purpose: Show a map made with symbols and the key that explains every symbol: 2 shelves, 1 table with 4 chairs, a door and one red dot for the hidden bookmark.
images.composition: A plan of the library corner seen from above on the left, with no text on it, and its key panel with four rows on the right, with a compass card at the top right.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. At the top, centred at x 728 and y 55, the heading A library corner seen from above in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px). PLAN: the floor is a rectangle x 80 to 800 and y 110 to 690 (white fill) with four dark #2B2B2B walls of 6 px: the top wall from x 80 to 800 at y 110; the left (west) wall from y 110 to 690 at x 80; the right wall from y 110 to 690 at x 800; the bottom (south) wall in two pieces, from x 80 to 400 and from x 500 to 800 at y 690, leaving a gap x 400 to 500 for the door. SHELVES: exactly 2 shelves, each a rectangle 44 by 170 px with a dark outline (3 px) filled amber #E69F00, along the west wall: shelf 1 at x 96 to 140 and y 190 to 360, shelf 2 at x 96 to 140 and y 420 to 590. TABLE: exactly 1 table, a square 120 by 120 px at x 340 to 460 and y 330 to 450 with a dark outline (3 px) filled green #009E73. CHAIRS: exactly 4 chairs, each a square 36 by 36 px with a dark outline (3 px) filled teal #0072B2, one on each side of the table: top at x 382 to 418 and y 286 to 322; bottom at x 382 to 418 and y 458 to 494; left at x 296 to 332 and y 372 to 408; right at x 468 to 504 and y 372 to 408. RED DOT: exactly 1 dot of radius 14 filled red #D55E00 with a dark outline (2 px), centred on the table at x 400 and y 390. PATH: one dashed dark #2B2B2B line (4 px, dashes 18 px with 12 px gaps) from the middle of the door gap at x 450 and y 690 straight up to x 450 and y 462, with a dark arrow head (18 px) pointing up at its top end. The plan itself carries no text. KEY PANEL: one rounded rectangle (corner radius 20 px) at x 860 to 1400 and y 250 to 700, white fill, dark outline 4 px; the heading Key in dark bold (40 px) centred at x 1130 and y 300. Row 1, centred at y 380: a rectangle 90 by 30 px centred at x 930 with a dark outline (3 px) filled amber #E69F00, and the word Shelf in dark bold (36 px) left aligned at x 1000. Row 2, centred at y 470: a square 50 by 50 px at x 905 to 955 and y 445 to 495 with a dark outline filled green #009E73, with 4 small squares of 16 by 16 px filled teal #0072B2 with a dark outline (2 px) around it (top at x 922 to 938 and y 423 to 439; bottom at x 922 to 938 and y 501 to 517; left at x 883 to 899 and y 462 to 478; right at x 961 to 977 and y 462 to 478), and the words Table and chairs in dark bold (36 px) left aligned at x 1000. Row 3, centred at y 560: a dark 6 px horizontal line from x 880 to 915 and another from x 945 to 980 at y 560, with a gap between them, and the word Door in dark bold (36 px) left aligned at x 1000. Row 4, centred at y 650: one red #D55E00 dot of radius 16 with a dark outline (2 px) centred at x 930, and the words Hidden bookmark in dark bold (36 px) left aligned at x 1000. COMPASS: A compass card, a square 110 by 110 px centred at x 1345 and y 155 (x 1290 to 1400, y 100 to 210), white fill, dark #2B2B2B outline 4 px, with N at its top centre, S at its bottom centre and W at its left centre in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (30 px), and E at its right centre in red #D55E00 bold (30 px), and a thin dark cross of two 3 px lines, each 50 px long, centred on the card between the four letters. In all: 2 shelves, 1 table, 4 chairs, 1 door gap, 1 red dot, 1 key panel with 4 symbols, 1 compass card. No other text and nothing else in the frame.
labels: A library corner seen from above
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any label written on the map itself, because the key explains every symbol
a shelf, table, chair or door drawn in a different count from 2 shelves, 1 table, 4 chairs and 1 door gap, or more than one red dot
images.takeaway: Every symbol on the map is explained in the key, and the red dot shows the hidden bookmark under the table: from the door, walk north to the table.
images.description: A plan of a library corner with 2 shelves, a table with 4 chairs, a door and a red dot under the table, next to a key that explains each symbol, with a compass.
images.context: Concept image for Making a Map with a Key. It follows the idea of the sample school map and its key in your maths book (symbols on a map, a key that explains them, red dots for hidden objects) and uses this concept's own example, a library corner.
images.teaching_notes: Let the student take each symbol on the plan and find it in the key, then follow the dotted path from the door north to the table. The slip to watch: drawing a symbol on the map that is not in the key.

image_decisions.why: The plan next to its key shows that every symbol on a map must be explained in the key, which words alone do not.
